characteristics.$text: Once per Battle per Unit: You can use this ability in any command phase at the start of it. All **friendly** units are no longer **battle-shocked** and/or **pinned**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per turn when a **friendly** unit withing 12" takes a **leadership test** it can use this models **leadership**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per battle, per unit In your **shooting** phase you can activate this ability. Select up to 2 **Pistol** that do not have the **[torrent]** weapons this model has then select 1 **enemy** unit withing range of both weapons. Make a shooting attack against that unit 6 times with both guns however if the weapon has **[Hazardous]** you must make the roll after each attack and if you fail you can no longer make attacks for that weapon for the rest of the turn. You can not re-roll any **hit rolls** made by these attacks.
